summary.answer:
I pulled 19,770 order items from 2023, joined with products, into `/data/order_items_2023.parquet`. Outerwear & Coats brought in the most revenue in 2023, followed by Jeans, Sweaters, Swim and Fashion Hoodies & Sweatshirts.

**How I counted revenue:** I used `sale_price` and left out items with status Cancelled ($173k) or Returned ($110k). Counting every item regardless of status gives the same top 5 in the same order.

**Top 5 categories by 2023 revenue**

| # | Category | Revenue | Share of all categories | Revenue incl. cancelled/returned |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Outerwear & Coats | $106.8k | 12.0% | $144.5k |
| 2 | Jeans | $101.5k | 11.4% | $132.8k |
| 3 | Sweaters | $68.7k | 7.7% | $91.6k |
| 4 | Swim | $56.1k | 6.3% | $73.9k |
| 5 | Fashion Hoodies & Sweatshirts | $53.8k | 6.1% | $70.6k |

**Monthly revenue ($)**, saved to `/work/top5_monthly_net_revenue.csv`

| Month | Outerwear | Jeans | Sweaters | Swim | Hoodies |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Jan | 9,814 | 6,315 | 5,566 | 4,529 | 4,230 |
| Feb | 8,481 | 7,396 | 4,020 | 3,754 | 3,419 |
| Mar | 9,929 | 7,837 | 5,195 | 3,798 | 3,419 |
| Apr | 9,126 | 7,037 | 4,192 | 4,698 | 4,349 |
| May | 6,605 | 9,084 | 6,735 | 4,158 | 4,381 |
| Jun | 9,927 | 9,238 | 5,328 | 4,352 | 4,631 |
| Jul | 10,620 | 8,506 | 7,814 | 4,003 | 4,400 |
| Aug | 8,467 | 9,338 | 5,392 | 5,162 | 4,114 |
| Sep | 8,013 | 7,498 | 5,901 | 4,313 | 6,599 |
| Oct | 6,311 | 10,197 | 5,776 | 5,028 | 4,859 |
| Nov | 8,790 | 9,651 | 5,151 | 6,297 | 4,187 |
| Dec | 10,685 | 9,429 | 7,606 | 6,033 | 5,162 |

**Trends (first half vs second half of the year)**
- **Outerwear & Coats** was flat (about −2%) and swung a lot from month to month, between $6.3k and $10.7k. It led most months, but Jeans beat it in May, August, October and November.
- **Jeans** grew steadily, by about 16%. It went from about $6–7k a month early in the year to $9–10k later on, peaking at $10.2k in October. It is close to taking first place.
- **Sweaters** grew about 21%, with high points in July ($7.8k) and December ($7.6k).
- **Swim** grew about 22%. Its strongest months were November and December, not summer, so its timing doesn't look tied to the season.
- **Hoodies** grew about 20%, with a one-month jump in September ($6.6k).

All five categories ended the year high, with December among their strongest months. thelook is a synthetic demo dataset, so these patterns may not reflect real buying seasons.

run.prompt: Pull 2023 order_items joined with products (category, brand, sale_price, created_at, status) into a file, then with DuckDB find the top 5 categories by revenue and how their monthly revenue evolved.

input.sql:
SELECT oi.id AS order_item_id, oi.order_id, p.category, p.brand, oi.sale_price, oi.created_at, oi.status
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` oi
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE oi.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2023-01-01' AND oi.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01'
input.description: 2023 order_items joined with products: category, brand, sale_price, created_at, status

input.sql: SELECT status, count(*) n, round(sum(sale_price),0) rev FROM '/data/order_items_2023.parquet' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC

output.columns: status VARCHAR, n BIGINT, rev DOUBLE
output.rows:
status,n,rev
Shipped,5973,352740
Complete,5003,300817
Processing,3948,234806
Cancelled,2940,173369
Returned,1906,109991

input.sql:
SELECT category, round(sum(sale_price) FILTER (WHERE status NOT IN ('Cancelled','Returned')),0) net_rev,
 round(sum(sale_price),0) gross_rev, count(*) items,
 round(100*net_rev/sum(net_rev) OVER (),1) pct_net
FROM '/data/order_items_2023.parquet' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY net_rev DESC LIMIT 8

output.columns: category VARCHAR, net_rev DOUBLE, gross_rev DOUBLE, items BIGINT, pct_net DOUBLE
output.rows:

Swim,56125,73900,1314,6.3
Fashion Hoodies & Sweatshirts,53750,70623,1299,6.1
Suits & Sport Coats,50390,65060,546,5.7
Sleep & Lounge,47940,62327,1226,5.4
Shorts,40838,54250,1164,4.6

input.sql:
WITH m AS (
 SELECT strftime(created_at,'%m') mon, category, sum(sale_price) rev
 FROM '/data/order_items_2023.parquet'
 WHERE status NOT IN ('Cancelled','Returned')
   AND category IN ('Outerwear & Coats','Jeans','Sweaters','Swim','Fashion Hoodies & Sweatshirts')
 GROUP BY ALL)
PIVOT (SELECT mon, category, round(rev,0) rev FROM m) ON category USING sum(rev) ORDER BY mon

output.columns: mon VARCHAR, Fashion Hoodies & Sweatshirts DOUBLE, Jeans DOUBLE, Outerwear & Coats DOUBLE, Sweaters DOUBLE, Swim DOUBLE
